summary: The 'Sign Up' button was successfully centered as per the design intent, but the 'Username' and 'Password' form labels were unintentionally centered as well.

regressions.explanation: The 'Username' label text-align changed from start to center, likely caused by CSS intended only for centering the button being applied to the entire form.
The 'Password' label text-align changed from start to center, likely caused by CSS intended only for centering the button being applied to the entire form.
